question: Which of the following books is written by Sanjiv Sahota, a winner of the European Union Prize for Literature?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Year of the Runaways**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Year of the Runaways**

 
 
• 'The Year of the Runaways is **Sunjeev Sahota's second book**, and he is a **British novelist**. 
 
• After being **released in June 2015, it was shortlisted for the 2015 Man Booker Prize** and received the **2017 European Union Prize for Literature (for the UK)**.
 
• The book follows the **lives of three migrant workers who flee India to look for work in England**.
 
• The plot of the book **centres on the interactions between three young men and one woman over the period of four seasons**, during which their aspirations, physical capabilities, and religious beliefs are tested.
